access.title: MCP access
access.descriptionPre: Controls which MCP commands the AI agent may invoke. Disabled commands return a “disabled in panel” notice to the agent and have no effect on the engine. Commands marked
access.descriptionPost: grant the agent write access and require explicit confirmation to enable. The MCP endpoint is served at

columnDescriptions.on: This column shows whether the MCP command is currently enabled.
columnDescriptions.command: This column shows the MCP command name exposed to the agent.
columnDescriptions.description: This column explains what the command lets the agent do.
columnDescriptions.flags: This column shows safety and implementation flags for the command.

table.disabledNotice: Disabled - returns a “disabled in panel” notice to the agent.

dialog.title: Enable protected command?
dialog.body1Post: . Enabling it grants the AI agent the ability to change the database in ways the operator cannot supervise or control in real time.
dialog.body2: This is a protective barrier against autonomous AI actions. Only enable it if you intend to grant the agent that power and accept the associated risk.

health.description: Report Pit Officer deployment health (engine version/profile/liveness, store reachability).

get_account_state.description: Read an account row and its account-scoped risk barriers.

get_limits.description: List configured risk barriers, optionally filtered by account.

list_orders.description: List orders with filters, including the trading-connection filter, sorting and paging.

list_trades.description: List trades with filters, including the trading-connection filter, sorting and paging.

list_accounts.description: List accounts with filters, including the trading-connection filter, sorting and paging.

list_groups.description: List account groups with filters, including the trading-connection filter, sorting and paging.

check_order.description: Run a non-mutating pre-trade dry-run for an order (pass/reject + reasons); changes no state.

set_limit.description: Tighten a risk barrier: add one or make it stricter; loosening and removal are refused.

submit_order.description: Submit an order intent through pre-trade and obtain an approval envelope.

submit_drop_copy_order.description: Submit an unsigned drop-copy order. Policies retain their normal state changes, but policy rejects and account or group kill-switch blocks do not stop the order.

confirm_execution.description: Record confirmation history for a workflow order with no execution-report activity.

cancel.description: Cancel a workflow order with no execution-report activity.

report_fill.description: Apply an execution report - a fill, a commission or a lifecycle status - to an order; a terminal status closes the order and releases its remaining reservation. Attested on an ordinary order, signed unless eSign is off, and unattested on a drop-copy order.

get_credential_storage.description: Read whether stored credentials are sealed and which hold plaintext keys.

connect.title: Connect your agent
connect.subtitle: Connect an AI agent to this Pit Officer instance over MCP, or download a ready-made artifact.
connect.tokenNote: Works only for MCP. It cannot call the REST API or open the panel.
connect.openNote: Officer runs without a token: this agent needs none - and neither does any other program, container or agent on this computer.

claude.cliLabel: Add the connector with the Claude CLI
claude.desktopLabel: Or add this entry to your Claude Desktop config
claude.bridgeNote: Claude Desktop reaches a local server through the {{bridge}} bridge, which needs {{runtime}}.
claude.skillHint: Prefer a packaged skill? Download a self-contained Claude Agent Skill.

chatgpt.step1: Open your custom GPT or ChatGPT connector settings.
chatgpt.step2: Add an MCP connector pointing at the URL above.
chatgpt.step3: Or build a ChatGPT Action from the OpenAPI description at /docs.
chatgpt.publicUrlCaveat: Hosted ChatGPT runs outside this computer and reaches only a public HTTPS address. Officer stays on this computer and serves plain HTTP, so hosted ChatGPT cannot connect to it. Connect an agent that runs on this computer instead.
chatgpt.instructionsHint: Download instruction text for a custom GPT.
